channel.title: Liberia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Liberia, every source cited.

item.title: Swiss court upholds Kosiah's 20-year war crimes sentence
item.description: Former ULIMO commander Alieu Kosiah will serve 20 years for atrocities in Lofa County during Liberia's civil war.

item.title: Liberia receives 30 road machines for farming
item.description: Bong County's new heavy equipment aims to improve market access for farmers and rural families.

item.title: Liberia enrolls 409 volunteer teachers on payroll
item.description: Monrovia Consolidated School System classes resume after government commits to address salary and welfare issues.

item.title: Liberia group slams Boakai-Koung over poverty, pay gaps
item.description: STAND demands probe into president's son amid claims of US$14,000 salaries for some officials.

item.title: Whein Town residents demand landfill closure
item.description: Residents near Monrovia's Whein Town Landfill face swarms of flies, rodents, and foul smells, fearing health risks.
